mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtext('practice_coach_summary_proposal'), hashtext(CAST(#{userId} AS TEXT) || ':' || #{problemSlug})) ) locked_scope

INSERT INTO practice_coach_summary_proposal ( id, user_id, problem_slug, practice_session_id, source_run_id, source_tool_call_id, summary_markdown, base_coach_summary_revision, status, applied_coach_summary_revision, created_at, applied_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{problemSlug}, #{practiceSessionId}, #{sourceRunId}, #{sourceToolCallId}, #{summaryMarkdown}, #{baseCoachSummaryRevision}, #{status}, #{appliedCoachSummaryRevision}, #{createdAt}, #{appliedAt} ) RETURNING

UPDATE practice_coach_summary_proposal SET status = 'APPLIED', applied_coach_summary_revision = #{appliedCoachSummaryRevision}, applied_at = #{appliedAt} WHERE id = #{proposalId} AND status = 'PENDING' RETURNING
UPDATE practice_coach_summary_proposal SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE id = #{proposalId} AND status = 'PENDING' RETURNING

SELECT message.id AS assistant_message_id, proposal.id AS proposal_id, proposal.status, CASE WHEN proposal.base_coach_summary_revision = 0 THEN 'CREATE' ELSE 'REPLACE' END AS operation, proposal.summary_markdown, proposal.applied_coach_summary_revision, proposal.created_at, proposal.applied_at FROM practice_coach_summary_proposal proposal JOIN agent_message message ON message.run_id = proposal.source_run_id AND message.role = 'assistant' AND message.status = 'active' WHERE proposal.user_id = #{userId} AND proposal.practice_session_id = #{practiceSessionId} AND message.id IN
#{messageId}
